body:
Hello,

I run PokemonDealFinder (pokemondealfinder.com). Your Trading Card Statistics (2026) roundup is carefully sourced, so a small dated dataset might be useful for it.

We published a 30-day sample: between 12 August 2026 and 11 September 2026 the median of 150 sampled product records moved +1.7%, while 22.1% of the 1,147 individual variants fell more than 1% against 4.7% of product records.

The limitations matter and are on the page: these are reference-price observations, not completed sales, and the sample is not random (150 records, 50 per era group), so it describes the sample rather than the hobby. Methodology: https://pokemondealfinder.com/market-data/pokemon-reference-price-changes

Happy for you to cite it if it fits. No reply needed otherwise.

subject: A companion guide to your set symbol page
body:
Hi PokeCottage team,

I run PokemonDealFinder (pokemondealfinder.com). Your set symbol page explains where the symbol sits next to the card number, and I wrote a guide that picks up from there: how to read the collector number itself.

It covers Pokedex numbers versus collector numbers (the Generations Charmander prints both), numbers above the printed total like 215/203, and zero-padding, and it's clear that the number identifies the card but not which printing you have: https://pokemondealfinder.com/guides/how-to-find-pokemon-card-set-and-number

If it would help your readers alongside the scanner, you're welcome to link it. Entirely up to you.
